title: Local models get their own panel
summary: A merged change gives local models a panel built around memory, and Flowtunes makes music on the machine.

topics.angle: AI that runs on your own computer.

claims.text: Local models get their own bar icon and panel.
Flowtunes generates music with ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo.
The panel’s memory bar shows what each running model holds and whether the next one fits.
